patch.value: Spawn N concurrent Rust mutation processes against one workspace and assert every accepted mutation survives, using the existing per-item lock and lock wait budget rather than a new primitive.

N independent processes mutate one item concurrently;every mutation that exits success is present in the final item and history stream;lock conflicts are retried within the configured wait budget instead of failing fast

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Added tests/concurrency_contract.rs: 8 concurrent OS processes each append 3 comments to one shared item using the per-item lock and its configured wait_ms budget (60s in the fixture), with no test-side coordination. Asserts every accepted mutation survives: comment-row count, history record count, and the before_hash/after_hash chain all agree with the 24 successful processes. The test found and fixed a real race: locate_item read the document before lock acquisition, so writers could apply changes to stale bytes; reads now happen inside the critical section for update, comment, and close. Lock-guard sabotage verified: releasing the lock immediately reproduces lost updates and fails the test.
